checks.name: VA [canonical: the capped phantom's cluster contribution] the equilibrated phantom, EFE-capped at the internal/external crossover, supplies a fraction of the certified 6.88x residual; the rest is free outer dust
checks.measured: field table: g_int falls from 8 a_0 (75 kpc) to 0.67 a_0 (420 kpc) while the Hubble-flow external is 6.99 a_0 -- the equilibrated regime (g ~ a_0) is outside the window; r_cap = none within 5000 kpc -- the cluster is deep Newtonian throughout; M_ph(<420 kpc)/M_b = 0.000; the free-dust remainder = 6.88x M_b (100% of the residual)
checks.reading: the architecture's verdict, quantified: the equilibrated phantom supplies AT MOST A SMALL FRACTION of the cluster residual -- the field is 1-8 a_0 across the window (deep Newtonian at the Hubble footing), so the equilibrium regime does not exist inside it. The BULK of the cluster's dark mass is free outer dust. This is the honest close of the cluster gate: the identification is LCDM-shaped at cluster scale BY ITS OWN ARCHITECTURE, and the theory says so. What the identification DOES supply at clusters is the shape of the inner transition (G008's -1.478) and the temperature floor -- and the galaxy-scale phenomenology entirely
